title: Set 1  Our New Classroom
subtitle: 对应课本：Unit 1 My classroom

dialogue.t: Hi, Amy! Look! This is our new classroom.
Wow! It's big and clean. What's in the classroom?
There is a picture on the wall. There are two lights and a fan.
It's near the door. A computer is on the teacher's desk.
Let's clean the classroom! I can clean the window.
Good! I can clean the board.

vocab: classroom 教室 · window 窗户 · board 黑板 · picture 图画 · wall 墙 · light 灯 · fan 风扇 · door 门 · computer 电脑

sections.title: A. 判断对错（T 对，F 错）

questions.why: 第一句 This is our new classroom。

questions.stem: The picture is on the door.
questions.why: 图画在墙上（on the wall），不在门上。

questions.stem: The computer is on the teacher's desk.
questions.why: A computer is on the teacher's desk.
Amy: I can clean the window.（board 是 Mike 擦）

questions.stem: How many lights are there in the classroom?
questions.why: Mike: There are two lights and a fan.
